name: Sprint Sled 2

origin.summary: An event from the 2014 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: The same 100-yard sled push as Sprint Sled 1, against a slightly longer cap.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2014/5 (official CrossFit Games event), retrieved 2026-07-09; separately scored from Sprint Sled 1
